data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003 depends on SRC_004 because the rubric: forbidden case for the school-to-seat binding's endpoint identity homogenization mutation structurally requires the same synchronous precondition check architecture that SRC_004 establishes for the lease-mismatch temporal constraint.
